name: Agent Squad
tagline: Stop move shoot. Clear floors. Next.
intro: Play as a spy infiltrating a high rise building. Stop moving to automatically fire at enemies. Dodge their attacks while clearing each floor. Defeat all foes to open a chest and advance to the next level. A mix of positioning and precise timing.

name: Animal Shifting
tagline: Shift animals to race. Finish first.
intro: Shift between animals to match obstacles. Use monkey to climb leopard to sprint fish to swim and bird to fly. Overcome every barrier and be the first racer to reach the goal.

name: Ball Racing 3D
tagline: Roll race dodge collect. Speed on.
intro: Race on a floating sky track as a rolling ball. Dodge obstacles and collect coins. Grab power ups to boost speed. Push forward to finish first. Simple tilt or touch controls.

name: Battle Ship
tagline: Pirate ship fight. Sink them all.
intro: Control a pirate ship and attack other players. Dodge enemy cannon fire and sink your foes. Gain experience to unlock powerful skills like multi shots and giant cannonballs. Fight to become the last ship sailing.

name: Beat Blader
tagline: Slice to the beat. Keep combos.
intro: A rhythm game where you slash blocks in time with the music. Follow the beat to keep your combo alive. Higher combos earn bigger scores. Miss the rhythm and the chain ends. Clean visuals and pumping tracks.

name: Cat Pinball
intro:
*经典弹球游戏与战斗探险的巧妙结合！快跟猫猫一起出发！
*在随机生成的地图中选择合适的路线，多种丰富事件等你探索！
*点击控制摇杆击飞小球，使小球在单个回合内获取尽可能高的分数，打出更高伤害！
*多种增益待你解锁，属性攻击、范围攻击、多重攻击......一切都可通过弹球获取，利用一颗弹球，打出暴击伤害！

name: Christmas Nail Salon
tagline: 绚丽美甲，丰富样式，不被他人定义！
intro:
节日来临前好好打扮一番吧！
真实美甲流程模拟，每一步都由你掌控
多种美甲造型可选，不同部位自由修饰
丰富颜色可供搭配，创造独属于你的美甲

name: Crazy Artillery
intro: 操控泡泡弹射手，瞄准发射泡泡，击碎敌方军团，策略走位，轻松闯关解压，挑战你的精准射击！

name: Drag The Block
remark: 游戏适配有问题，无法适配当前屏幕

name: Fusion and Elimination
intro: 《Fusion & Elimination》是一款经典数字合成消除游戏：玩家通过滑动 / 点击合并相同数字方块，不断合成更大数值，挑战更高分数。游戏机制简单易懂，上手轻松，随着方块数值不断升级，考验你的策略规划与反应速度，节奏明快又上头，适合喜欢数字挑战与休闲解压的玩家。

name: Glam Girl Dress Up And Makeover
Hexagon
intro: 将数字六边形拖入棋盘，连接3个及以上相同数字即可合并升级，合理布局并连击冲击高分。

name: Jump In Rhythm To The Hit Cat Disco
Nuts Sort Puzzle
intro: 点击螺母在螺栓间移动，同色螺母全部归位即可过关，考验观察与排序策略。

name: Paper Doll Diary Dress Up Diy
Paper.io 2
intro: 操控方块沿地图滑行圈占地盘，返回己方区域即可扩张版图，同时避开对手尾迹完成击杀。

name: Sokoban Escape
intro: 《密室逃脱》是一款经典推箱子解谜游戏：玩家操控角色在石砖迷宫中推动木箱，将其精准推至指定位置，触发机关开门逃生。关卡设计巧妙，考验空间推理与步序规划能力，操作简洁，节奏紧凑，适合喜欢逻辑挑战的玩家。

name: Suako Fruit
intro: 发射数字水果球，让相同数字碰撞合并升级，在有限空间内不断合成更高等级水果。
